answer: A mechanism that actually bites: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because quartz only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, summit is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any velvet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
